leave.bodyUpload: If you leave this page, the invoice upload starts over; the column mapping and invoice details will be lost.

org.switchFailed: The company could not be changed. Try again.
org.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. They will be lost if you switch company. Continue?

readOnly.title: The subscription is in read-only mode.
readOnly.body: You can view and export records but cannot make changes. Contact your company admin.

offline.title: Could not reach the server
offline.body: You are still signed in. Check your internet connection and try again. If the problem continues, the server may be down.

access.mobileTitle: This role works in the mobile app
access.mobileBody: Your {{tool}} role is {{role}}. You take measurements in the SellerOnData Android app.
access.mobileStep1: Your admin will share the Android app. Install it on your phone.
access.noAccessTitle: You do not have access to {{tool}}
access.noAccessBody: You have no tool role in this company, or the company has no active subscription. Ask your company admin to give you a role on the Team and permissions page in Hub.
access.orgBody: DeciShip data belongs to a company. Select the company you want to work in.
access.noOrgTitle: You are not a member of a company yet
access.noOrgBody: Ask your company admin for an invitation, or continue in Hub.
access.forbiddenTitle: This page is not open to your role
access.forbiddenBody: If you think this is a mistake, contact your company admin. Permissions are managed in Hub.
access.tariffEditBody: You can view tariffs and calculate prices. To add or import a tariff, contact your company admin.
access.tariffEditReadOnly: The subscription is read-only: tariffs can't be added or imported. You can still view tariffs and calculate prices.
access.mobileStep3: Scan the parcel, measure it, save.
access.mobileAppSlot: The app is not in the stores yet and there is no iOS version. Ask your admin for the install file.
access.suspendedTitle: Your membership in this company is suspended
access.suspendedPickBody: Contact your admin. Meanwhile you can continue with another company you belong to.
access.suspendedBody: Contact your admin. You continue where you left off once it is resumed.
access.noAccessMobile: If you will measure parcels in the warehouse, ask your administrator for the Measurement role; measurements are recorded in the SellerOnData Android app.

company.name: Company name
company.managedInHub: The company name is managed in Hub and looks the same in every tool.
company.askAdmin: Contact your company admin to change it.

team.title: Add your team in Hub
team.body: Invite warehouse staff and other users on the Team and permissions page in Hub. Phone invitations create a one-time code.
team.askAdmin: The company owner or an admin manages the team and permissions.

lang.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes. Changing the language reloads the page and these changes are lost. Continue?

sessionLost.label: Session
sessionLost.title: Your session has ended
sessionLost.body: What you typed was not saved. You can stay on this page and copy it. After signing in you return to this page, but unsaved text does not come back.
sessionLost.bar: Your session has ended. What you typed was not saved; copy it, then sign in again.

record.title: This record is not in this company
record.body: The link may belong to another company, or the record may have been deleted.
record.otherOrgs: It may be in another of your companies. Switch and check:
